title: AX56 Bring-up
profTagline: Watch a Wi-Fi 6 chip boot from cold to firmware, register by register
installDesc: Add to your home screen for a full-screen bring-up.
installIosHint: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: Open the browser menu and choose Install.
connectBody: Connect an RTL8852AU (ASUS USB-AX56). In the app it switches the adapter out of storage mode and reads its live registers onto the lattice; in desktop Chrome it reads an already-switched adapter. Watch the demo for the full cold-to-firmware bring-up.
noUsb: Live reading needs the native driver. Watch the bring-up here.
